scenario_name: Persist one synthetic customer's financial records
application_identity: An existing local verified user is used; no fixture login identity is created
api_walkthrough: Register and verify a local demo user
Create or reuse that user's financial account metadata
Upload a UTF-8 CSV statement with a stable Idempotency-Key
Inspect the owner-scoped import batch and validation result
Request a single-currency posted-only cashflow summary
Repeat the seed/import and confirm no duplicate transaction rows were created
expected_safety: Every loaded row is labeled SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE
No fake application user or login credentials are created
No bank, provider, payment or government endpoint is contacted
No raw uploaded CSV bytes are retained
